extracted.name: Mimosa
extracted.description: Mix a classic mimosa cocktail with orange juice and champagne – or use prosecco if you prefer a different bubbly. It's an easy fix when entertaining or for brunch.
instruction_lines: Half-fill each of 6 glasses with champagne, then carefully pour in the orange juice until the glass is full.
